provenance: Hand-derived by reading tools-service source on disk at commit 324fc271d83f4db8a8ca9f7fdc01f94a1a4cc271 (2026-09-26). Not captured from a running service. Field names, types and status codes are the ones the named handler produces; data values (paths, timings, descriptions, emoji) are illustrative. Re-derive when the named files change.

toolSchemas.from: src/routes/AdminRoutes.ts GET /tool-schemas -> src/services/ToolSchemaService.ts getToolSchemas(); entry type ToolSchema in src/types/tools.ts; definitions copied from src/services/tool-definitions/FinanceTools.ts (get_historical_prices) and CoreWorkspaceTools.ts (write_file, get_background_output). tools-service definitions carry no additionalProperties key.

body.name: get_historical_prices
body.description: Historical OHLCV prices for a ticker.

body.name: write_file
body.description: Write a file inside the workspace.

body.name: get_background_output
body.description: Read the output of a background process.

adminConfig.from: src/routes/AdminRoutes.ts GET /config: res.json({ workspaceRoots: ALLOWED_ROOTS, agents }); agent entry from src/services/AgentConnectionManager.ts getConnectedAgents(). The handler sends no other key.

adminConfigNoAgents.from: same handler, with no workspace agent connected

workspacesUpdated.from: src/routes/AdminRoutes.ts PUT /config/workspaces success: res.json({ workspaceRoots, userRoots, errors }). A rejected path is reported inside a 200.

workspacesRejected.from: src/routes/AdminRoutes.ts PUT /config/workspaces when roots is not an array

body.error: 'roots' must be an array of path strings

validateVerdict.from: src/routes/AdminRoutes.ts POST /config/workspaces/validate: an invalid path is a 200 verdict with the reason in error

validateRejected.from: src/routes/AdminRoutes.ts POST /config/workspaces/validate when path is missing or not a string

health.from: src/server.ts app.get('/health'): { status, uptime, domains }. The per-domain health objects are omitted here.

filesystemList.from: src/routes/FilesystemRoutes.ts GET /list -> src/services/AgenticFileService.ts agenticGetDirectoryTree(): { entries }, entry { name, path, type: 'directory' | 'file', children? }

filesystemListRejected.from: src/routes/FilesystemRoutes.ts returns { error } and src/utilities.ts agenticHandler turns it into 400 { code, retryable, error }

worktreeCreateFailed.from: agenticGitWorktreeCreate() returns { error, repoPath }; agenticHandler answers 400 with { code, retryable, ...result }

body.error: fatal: a branch named 'orchestrator/agent-1' already exists

worktreeForbidden.from: agenticHandler answers 403 when classifyAgenticError() returns FORBIDDEN (message matches /outside allowed|blocked/)

worktreeDiff.from: tools-service tests/fixtures/worktree-diff-contract.json, copied whole. src/services/AgenticGitService.ts says both repositories pin this file as the worktree diff contract (type WorktreeDiff: branch, base, files[{ path, status, previousPath? }], patch, stats{ filesChanged, additions, deletions }, patchTruncated?).

shellStream.from: src/routes/ComputeRoutes.ts POST /shell/stream: start, chunks, exit { exitCode, executionTimeMs, success, timedOut, error? }. Frames are written by setupStreamingServerSentEvents as 'data: <json>\n\n'.

jsStream.from: src/routes/ComputeRoutes.ts POST /js/stream: the exit event has exitCode, executionTimeMs, success only (no timedOut, no error); a failure is a stderr chunk plus exitCode 1

pythonStream.from: src/routes/UtilityRoutes.ts POST /python/stream: exit { exitCode, executionTimeMs, success, timedOut, error?, inputFiles?, figure payload? }

commandStreamAborted.from: src/routes/AgenticRoutes.ts POST /command/stream: exit { exitCode, executionTimeMs, success, timedOut, aborted?, error? }; aborted is true when the caller disconnected

streamRejected.from: every stream route validates the body before it opens the stream and answers 400 { error } as JSON (ComputeRoutes.ts /shell/stream shown)

fileWritten.from: src/services/AgenticFileService.ts agenticWriteFile() success: { filePath, created, overwritten, bytesWritten, linesWritten }

fileWriteRejected.from: src/routes/AgenticRoutes.ts POST /file/write returns { error }; agenticHandler answers 400 { code, retryable, error }

handlerTimedOut.from: src/utilities.ts agenticHandler catch branch: 504 { error, code: 'TIMEOUT', retryable: true } when the handler exceeds AGENTIC_HANDLER_TIMEOUT_MS (src/constants.ts, 150_000)
